svg.text: Generated by tools/figures/concept_readme.py from ConceptOperations.sysml, CONOPS.md, safety/hazards/ and requirements/. Concept stage: hazards and requirements are drafts, risk is preliminary.

g.text: Terms: CONOPS = concept of operations · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · SCN-nnn = CONOPS scenario (SCN-0nn nominal, SCN-1nn off-nominal) · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
